<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 183.0451 corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of 182.0378 Da. The isotopic pattern (significant M+2 peak at ~33 % intensity) indicates the presence of a chlorine atom. Accounting for one Cl (35Cl) and fitting the exact mass with C, H, O, and an additional N yields the formula C₉H₉ClNO, which matches the observed mass within <3 ppm.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H9ClNO</final_answer>
